parsed.summary: The PR removes a post_init signal handler from ImageField, which could lead to unexpected behavior if width_field or height_field are set in the future.

issues.description: The change removes the post_init signal handler unconditionally, which could lead to unexpected behavior if width_field or height_field are set in the future. This introduces a behavioral regression risk.
